en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Gonta wanna cook for friends!
Put smiles on faces!
Gonta no can let Shuichi behave ungentlemanly!

You wanna rummage through trash for
food, gotta defeat Gonta first!

Oh, hmm... Why gentlemen and tea always
go together?
Will Gonta understand if he drink lots of tea?

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
